title: How Vacation Rental Property Managers Automate Financial Operations with Ramp + Topkey
summary: Best Ramp integration for short-term rental property managers. Topkey automates receipt capture, eliminates manual data entry, and streamlines month-end close.
body_markdown:
If you are a short-term rental property manager, you know the pain. Your team uses Ramp cards to earn rewards and manage expenses across properties. But that data has to flow through your PMS and accounting software. Without a bridge between them, that data gets hunted down, manually coded, and entered twice. Once in your PMS. Once in your accounting software.


As you grow, one hundred charges turn into thousands and now what used to take a few hours takes days or even weeks of manual work during month-end close. The problem isn't Ramp. It's the gap between Ramp and the systems STR operators rely on to run their businesses.


The Ramp + Topkey integration closes this gap. Create virtual Ramp cards, spread them across your team, keep the rewards. Set up and run a[monthly financial operating system](https://topkey.io/expense-management) in Topkey built for STR operators. Your team captures receipts and tags properties at the moment of charge, data syncs to your PMS and accounting, and by month-end the heavy lifting is done.


In this article, we'll walk through exactly how a manual expense management process breaks month-end close and how the integration reclaims days of work every month.


## Manual Work Slows Month-End Close


Here's the gap that Ramp and Topkey partnered to solve. A Ramp card charge clears, but without an integration, your team has no instant visibility, no alert, and no automatic receipt or categorization. Someone has to hunt for the receipt, match it manually to the transaction, code it by property, enter it into your PMS, and then enter it again into your accounting software, two separate manual entries for a single charge.


For an operator managing a hundred properties, this receipt tracking nightmare and dual-entry process cost them 100+ hours of extra work each month across the team.. A single property with ten transactions might take thirty minutes to reconcile across systems. Scale to multiple one thousand properties and hundreds of cards, and that thirty-minute task stretches into a 2-week reconciliation project.


## How Ramp + Topkey Close the Loop


Instead of your team hunting for receipts and re-entering data twice, here's what actually happens when Ramp and Topkey connect.


### Create Virtual Ramp Cards inside Topkey


You don't have to log into Ramp to issue cards.[Create virtual Ramp cards](https://topkey.io/features/bring-your-own-card) directly from Topkey, set spending limits, assign cardholders, and the card is issued in Ramp. Your entire team deploys cards from one place with no context-switching.


### Data Captured at Point of Sale, not After


When a charge happens, Topkey reads the transaction data from Ramp instantly, capturing vendor, amount, date, and cardholder information. The employee who made the charge gets a text with a link. They click through to Topkey,[upload the receipt](https://topkey.io/features/pms-automations) , and tag the property right then. The receipt and any field notes provide complete context at the moment of the transaction.


By the time month-end arrives, everything is already there. Already coded, just awaiting review. Your finance team doesn't have to dig through filing cabinets for receipts or store them away until month-end, and there's no limbo state between systems. They're reviewing and approving what's been captured and coded instead of hunting through email, recoding transactions, or guessing at what should go where.


### Approval Workflow Automates the Gate


Before any Ramp card charge touches your accounting software or PMS, it sits in[Topkey's approval workflow](https://topkey.io/features/approval-workflows) . Transactions that meet your approval exemptions flow downstream with no review needed. Anything outside those parameters, such as an amount outside your normal range, a new vendor, or a high-dollar transaction, routes to your team for review. Once all required approvals are complete, the data is ready to sync.


### Data Synced to Your PMS and Accounting Software


Once approved, Topkey syncs the transaction to your PMS automatically. For accounting software, you trigger the sync to QuickBooks, Xero, or your accounting platform when you're ready. No manual re-entry. No re-coding. Everything that was captured and coded at point of sale flows downstream exactly as intended.


### Month-End Turns into a Breeze


At month-end, all Ramp transactions are there, already coded by property and expense category with receipts attached and approvals complete. Your finance team reviews clean data that's organized exactly how they need it, ready to flow directly to your accounting software. What used to be a week-long receipt hunt, re-entry marathon, and spreadsheet scramble now takes hours.


### Proven Workflow Your Team Can Repeat Monthly


Your finance team has a repeatable[financial operating system](https://topkey.io/expense-management) built specifically for short-term rental operators. One they can trust as they continue to grow. Month after month, the same process delivers a predictable, manageable month-end close. That's what Ramp and Topkey together deliver.


## Results Using Ramp + Topkey Integration


When data captures at point of sale and flows through one approval gate instead of scattered across three systems, the results are immediate. Here's what operators see.


### No More Manual Work


With data captured at point of sale, Ramp card charges stop being a receipt-hunting and manual-coding project. Employees submit receipts and select properties when the charge happens, right in Topkey. By month-end, everything is already there and correctly coded. Your finance team reviews what's correct instead of hunting for missing receipts or recoding transactions. The receipt hunts disappear. The manual categorization stops. The re-keying between systems stops. For an operator managing a hundred properties, eliminating the manual receipt matching and entry can recover half of their month-end close time alone.


### Month-End Close without the Chaos


With data captured at point of sale, month-end close looks fundamentally different. You're not hunting for receipts in email or spreadsheets. You're not manually matching charges to properties. You're not re-coding transactions. You're reviewing and approving what's already been captured and coded correctly by your team. All Ramp transactions are in Topkey, already tagged by property. Receipts are attached. Categorization is correct. Owner statements are generated with clean, accurate expense data. Reconciliation is a final review and approval, not a data-entry marathon. When the approval workflow handles Ramp entry automatically, month-end compresses. A two-week month-end close compresses to 1 day. A ten-day close shrinks to one. The recovery compounds across properties, cardholders, and transactions. By removing the dual-entry bottleneck, operators can reclaim up to a 5 day work week per month they were spending on reconciliation work that the integration now handles automatically.


### One Centralized Hub to Manage Finances


[Topkey](https://topkey.io/) provides a single, unified system that automates your Ramp expenses, receipts,[approvals](https://topkey.io/features/approval-workflows) ,[bill pay](https://topkey.io/bill-pay) ,[inventory management](https://topkey.io/inventory-management) , and[revenue reconciliation](https://topkey.io/revenue-reconciliation) . Your finance team stops chasing data across systems and starts managing the operation. Julio Clavijo, CFO at Otium, describes what this actually means: "We connected our Ramp cards to Topkey, because Topkey is the main hub where our financial operations happen." Nothing slips through the cracks because every dollar is tracked and every approval is clear. Topkey gives you complete visibility and complete control.


### Keep Your Ramp Rewards


Ramp and Topkey were built to work together. Ramp does what it does best, issues cards and earns you rewards. Topkey does what it does best, automates your expense workflow with instant visibility, AI receipt matching, approvals, and syncs to your PMS and accounting. The result is corporate cards fully integrated into your vacation rental financial operation. Your team spends. Topkey captures it, codes it, and routes it to the right owner or property without manual work. Everything happens in one place, and the rewards pile up.


## How to Setup Ramp + Topkey Integration


Here's how to get the integration running. As a Topkey customer, you'll connect your Ramp account to Topkey, sync your cards and properties, and start creating virtual cards. All without leaving Topkey. The whole process takes about five minutes. Let's walk through it.


### How to Connect Ramp & Topkey


- Open your Topkey profile dropdown in the top left and click "Settings."
- Navigate to "Integrations" on the Settings page.
- Find "Ramp" under "Other integrations" and click it.
- You'll be redirected to Ramp's login page; log in with your Ramp account.
- Click "Authorize" on Ramp's site to approve the connection.
- You'll be brought back to Topkey.
- If you have multiple Ramp entities, select "All Entities" or a specific entity to scope the connection. Single-entity accounts skip this automatically.
- Once complete, you can create virtual Ramp cards directly from Topkey.


That's it. Your Ramp account is now connected to Topkey. Next, you'll sync your cards and properties so Topkey has everything it needs to manage your expenses.


### Sync Ramp Cards into Topkey


Once Ramp is connected, a single sync pull imports your latest cards, cardholders, and your PMS properties. From that moment on, Topkey knows which card belongs to which person and which properties exist to tag. Everything syncs automatically on a schedule you set, so you never have to re-enter the same data twice.


### Running Your First Ramp Sync


The first sync is where everything connects. It pulls all your Ramp data into Topkey and links it to your properties. Here's the step-by-step process:


- Open the Cards section from Topkey's main navigation.
- Click "Sync Ramp Cards" in the top action bar.
- Topkey imports all your Ramp cards and cardholders.
- Topkey sends a welcome email to any new cardholders and archives inactive cards.
- Run the sync again anytime to refresh Topkey with the latest data from Ramp.


From now on, you can set this sync to run automatically on a schedule, so your cards and properties stay current. Here's exactly what gets synced every time you run it.


### What Gets Synced and When


Each sync brings over everything Topkey needs to manage your expenses and integrate with your operation:


- Ramp cards (physical and virtual) and their spending limits.
- Cardholders and their roles.
- Ramp vendors, so you can pay bills without manually recreating vendor data.
- The sync runs on a schedule you set, keeping everything fresh without manual re-entry.


You now have everything Topkey needs to track every transaction and sync it downstream. Next, learn how to create virtual cards for new team members directly inside Topkey.


### Create Virtual Ramp Cards from inside Topkey


Bringing on a new maintenance contractor? Onboarding a property manager? You never have to log into Ramp.[Create the card directly in Topkey](https://topkey.io/features/bring-your-own-card) , set the spending limit, assign the cardholder, and the card is issued in Ramp instantly. Your entire team deploys cards from one place, no bouncing between Ramp and Topkey.


Here's a step-by-step guide on how to issue a virtual Ramp card in Topkey:


- Open the Cards section from Topkey's navigation.
- Click "Create Ramp Card" in the top action bar.
- Select the cardholder from the dropdown (they must already be synced from Ramp).
- Create a display name for the card, for example "Maintenance for Property 42."
- Set the spending limit you want to enforce.
- Choose your auto-sync interval so Topkey refreshes this card's data from Ramp on your schedule.
- Click "Create Card."
- The card appears in your Topkey cards list and is issued in Ramp.


**Key prerequisite:** The cardholder must be synced to Topkey from Ramp first. If they don't appear in the dropdown, make sure they're in Ramp, then click "Sync Ramp Cards" to bring them into Topkey before creating the card.


Now that you can create virtual Ramp cards in Topkey, learn how to manage them.


### Manage Card Lifecycle without Leaving Topkey


Every Ramp card (physical or virtual) appears in Topkey as an External Card with its current status. From Topkey, you can suspend a card if a property manager leaves or a contractor relationship ends, unsuspend it if they return, or terminate it permanently.

Receipt hunting, recoding, re-entry between systems. This challenge breaks down differently depending on your size. For solo operators, it means nights and weekends. For growing teams, it's a full week of your finance person's calendar consumed by reconciliation. For enterprise operations, it's an all-hands crisis that stretches into a two-week project.


More properties mean more transactions. More transactions mean more manual work. More manual work means more errors, more missing receipts, and more cash leakage hitting your bottom line. The integration solves this same problem at every scale by eliminating that manual bottleneck, so teams scale without cash leakage scaling with them. One system, everything connected. No more hunting receipts down and re-entering data between systems.That's the difference between month-end feeling like crisis management and feeling like routine work.

Close the gap and everything changes. Expenses captured at point of sale. Approvals consolidated in one place. Data flowing downstream automatically. By month-end, the heavy lifting is already done. ## FAQ


### 1. Do I Have to Migrate off My PMS or Accounting Software?


No. Your PMS, accounting software, and Ramp all stay exactly where they are. Topkey layers in between them as a connector. Your existing tools keep running. Ramp card data flows into Topkey, gets coded and approved, then syncs downstream to your PMS and accounting software automatically. You keep the systems you know and trust. Topkey bridges the gaps between them.


### 2. Which PMS Systems Work with Ramp + Topkey?


Topkey integrates directly with Guesty, Streamline, Track, Hostaway, Hospitable, OwnerRez, Hostfully, and Feather. Your PMS doesn't move or change. When a Ramp card charge comes in, Topkey reads it, cross-references it to your property, and syncs it directly into your PMS workflow with full context and property attribution already applied. Transaction data flows from Ramp through Topkey and into your property management system exactly as it should.


### 3. Which Accounting Software Does Topkey Work with?


Topkey syncs with QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, Xero, Sage Intacct, and NetSuite. When you're ready to close your books, Ramp transactions flow to your accounting software with full property coding and expense categorization already assigned. Your finance team receives clean, organized data ready to post. No re-entry. No recoding. Everything that was captured and categorized at point of sale in Topkey arrives in your accounting software exactly as intended.


### 4. How Long Does Setup Take?


Setup takes about five minutes to connect Ramp and Topkey via OAuth. A single sync pull imports your Ramp cards, cardholders, properties from your PMS, and Ramp vendors into Topkey. From that moment on, every Ramp card charge lands in Topkey with full context and real-time visibility. No manual configuration needed beyond that initial connection.


### 5. Do I Have to Manually Import My Ramp Card Data into My PMS?


Not with Topkey. Many property managers currently using Ramp have to export card transactions as spreadsheets and manually import them into their PMS, property by property. Topkey eliminates this entirely. Ramp card transactions are pulled automatically, matched to the correct property through your PMS integration, and synced directly into your workflow. No spreadsheets. No manual imports. No lost time during the month-end.


### 6. Can I See All My Expenses in One Place?


Absolutely. Topkey gives you a unified dashboard where Ramp card transactions, bank transfers, bill pay, vendor invoices, and other expenses all appear together. You see your complete financial picture, organized by property, vendor, category, and owner, without switching between systems. Complete visibility in one place.


### 7. Can I Create Virtual Ramp Cards in Topkey?


Create virtual Ramp cards directly in Topkey without logging into Ramp. Set spending limits, assign cardholders, name the card, and it's provisioned instantly. Virtual card spend is tracked, categorized, and approved through the same workflow as physical cards, with full property attribution and receipt capture at point of sale.
